name: Image Palette Extraction
description: Extract a usable color palette from an image or a set of images — the dominant and accent colors as hex/RGB with proportions — and emit it as design tokens (CSS variables / JSON) plus a swatch preview, so a brand or theme can be built from a reference photo. Lock FIRST how many colors, the color space and clustering method, and accessibility constraints (e.g. text/background pairs must meet a contrast ratio) because a raw dominant-color dump is rarely directly usable as a theme; then extract, name, and present the palette. Covers color extraction, palette generation, design tokens, theme-from-image, dominant colors, and brand color sampling.
